text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Glafcos Clerides goes to Athens today for talks with Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis.
- Cyprus Airways will have an expiry date if nothing is done about it soon, its chairman warns.
- S-300s 'unlikely ever to be deployed' says US envoy Carey Cavanaugh.
- Central Bank governor says interest rates are due to be deregulated soon.
- The US is keeping details of its initiative on Cyprus under wraps until Turkey, Greece and Cyprus reach an agreement on reducing tension on the island.
- Cyprus Airways boss warns airline is on the verge of collapse.
- MPs do not show up in parliament but are getting paid for it.
